note: ILLUSTRATIVE PLACEHOLDERS ONLY. Every material cost, labor hour, and margin in this template is a made-up example in a plausible US range so the quote flow can be demonstrated. These are NOT market prices, vendor quotes, or recommendations. Replace every value with your own costs, labor standards, and margins before sending any quote to a client. Descriptions are generic; specify makes, models, ratings, and code compliance yourself.

items.name: Chain-link fabric repair
items.description: Splice and re-tie damaged chain-link fabric at a cut or breach. Good tier: restores the barrier only.

items.name: Fabric repair plus bottom tension wire
items.description: Fabric repair plus a bottom tension wire and ties to resist lifting and crawling under. Better tier.

items.name: Fence section replacement with anti-climb mesh
items.description: Remove the damaged section and install anti-climb welded mesh panels with posts and footings. Best tier. Height and specification set per site.

items.name: Gate hinge, latch, and hasp repair
items.description: Repair or replace gate hinges, latch, and padlock hasp so the gate closes and secures. Good tier.

items.name: Pedestrian gate card reader and electric lock
items.description: Outdoor card reader, electric lock, and request-to-exit on a pedestrian gate, tied to the existing access control system. Better tier.

items.name: Vehicle gate operator with access control
items.description: Slide or swing gate operator with safety devices, vehicle loops, and reader or intercom on a pedestal. Best tier. Safety compliance specified by the installer.

items.name: Fixed steel pipe bollard (not crash rated)
items.description: Concrete-filled steel pipe bollard set in a footing to deter vehicle approach. Not crash rated. Good tier.

items.name: Crash-rated fixed bollard
items.description: Crash-rated bollard with engineered foundation. The rating and foundation design must be confirmed by the manufacturer and a site engineer. Best tier.

items.name: Perimeter private property sign
items.description: Weatherproof private property or no trespassing sign on fence or post. Wording per local requirements.

items.name: Wayfinding sign to public entrance
items.description: Post or wall sign directing visitors to the single public entrance.

items.name: Shrub and tree trim for sightlines
items.description: Subcontracted trim of shrubs and canopies that block sightlines, lights, or cameras, or crowd the perimeter clear zone. Good tier.

items.name: Remove overgrowth and replant low-growth
items.description: Remove overgrown shrubs that create concealment and replant with low-growth species. Better tier.

items.name: Relamp and repair existing fixture
items.description: Replace failed lamp or driver and clean the lens on an existing exterior fixture. Good tier.

items.name: Photocell replacement
items.description: Replace a failed or misreading photocell so fixtures switch on at dusk.

items.name: LED retrofit kit for pole or wall fixture
items.description: LED retrofit in an existing housing with a shielded optic to cut glare into cameras. Better tier.

items.name: New LED area light on pole
items.description: New pole, base, and LED area light to close a dark gap in a parking area or path. Trenching and power not included unless added. Best tier.

items.name: Re-aim, refocus, and clean camera
items.description: Adjust field of view, focus, and exposure and clean the dome or lens on an existing camera. Good tier.

items.name: Fixed dome IP camera with IR
items.description: Fixed dome IP camera with IR and wide dynamic range; resolution chosen for the identification or observation goal. Better tier.

items.name: Outdoor bullet IP camera with IR
items.description: Outdoor bullet IP camera with IR for perimeter, fence line, or parking coverage. Better tier.

items.name: Entrance identification camera
items.description: Narrow field of view camera with strong backlight handling, placed to capture faces at an entrance. Best tier.

items.name: Add drives to existing recorder
items.description: Add surveillance-rated drives to an existing recorder to reach the retention target. Good tier.

items.name: Network video recorder replacement
items.description: New recorder sized for camera count and retention, with health alerts and time sync configured. Better tier.

items.name: Video system cyber hardening
items.description: Change default passwords, update firmware, disable unused services, set time sync, and apply a secure configuration baseline to cameras and recorders.

items.name: Door position switch
items.description: Add a door position switch so the access system reports forced and held-open doors. Good tier.

items.name: Held-open alarm with door position switch
items.description: Door position switch plus a local sounder for propped doors and an alarm point to the access system. Better tier.

items.name: Card reader door package
items.description: Reader, electric strike or lock, request-to-exit, door position switch, and controller port for one door. Best tier for a door that is key only today.

items.name: Credential and access level audit
items.description: Reconcile active access cards against the HR roster, remove leavers, and tighten access levels.

items.name: Visitor management system
items.description: Visitor sign-in software with badge printing and host notification, per site per year, setup included.

items.name: Optical turnstile lane
items.description: Optical turnstile lane integrated with access control at the main entry. Best tier. Life safety and accessibility review required.

items.name: Rekey cylinder
items.description: Rekey an existing cylinder after lost keys or staff changes. Good tier.

items.name: Heavy duty commercial lever lockset
items.description: Heavy duty commercial lockset replacing residential or worn hardware on an exterior door; grade specified by the installer. Better tier.

items.name: Door frame reinforcement and security hinges
items.description: Strike and frame reinforcement with non-removable pin hinges. Better tier.

items.name: Exterior hollow metal door assembly
items.description: Replace a damaged or weak exterior door with a hollow metal door, frame, and hardware. Best tier. Fire rating and egress hardware per code.

items.name: Restricted key system with key cabinet
items.description: Move to a restricted keyway with a key issue log, a locking key cabinet, and scheduled combination changes. Best tier.

items.name: Accessible window lock and security film
items.description: Secondary lock and security film on a ground-floor or otherwise reachable window.

items.name: Door or window contact
items.description: Recessed or surface contact on an exterior opening, wired or wireless to the intrusion panel.

items.name: Dual-technology motion detector
items.description: Interior motion detector for high-value rooms and corridors.

items.name: Cellular alarm communicator
items.description: Add a cellular path so the panel still reports when phone or internet lines are cut. Good tier.

items.name: Intrusion panel replacement with dual-path reporting
items.description: New intrusion panel in a locked, tamper-protected enclosure with IP and cellular reporting. Best tier.

items.name: Panic or duress button
items.description: Fixed or wireless duress button at reception, cash handling, or other staff points.

items.name: Central station alarm monitoring
items.description: Monitored alarm service per panel per month, with a written response procedure and call list.

items.name: Post orders and incident log routine
items.description: Write or rewrite post orders per post (duties, patrols, escalation, emergencies) plus a daily log template and supervisor review checklist.

items.name: Guard tour verification system
items.description: Checkpoint tags and a patrol app with missed-checkpoint alerts and incident reporting, per site per year.

items.name: Two-way radio for officers
items.description: Business two-way radio with charger, programmed to the site channel plan.

items.name: Physical security policy writing
items.description: Write or update the physical security policy, including media destruction and signage rules.

items.name: Security awareness training session
items.description: Instructor-led session on physical and cyber awareness: tailgating, visitors, phishing, and reporting.

items.name: Cybersecurity policy set and roles
items.description: Core cybersecurity policy set with named roles, supplier security requirements, and an oversight cadence.

items.name: Cyber risk assessment and strategy workshop
items.description: Facilitated workshop to set risk appetite, record legal and regulatory requirements, and rank cyber risks.

items.name: Hardware, software, data, and network inventory
items.description: Discovery scan and documentation of hardware, software, services, data sets, and network and data flows.

items.name: Managed patching, per endpoint
items.description: Managed operating system and third-party patching per endpoint per month, with monthly vulnerability scan reporting.

items.name: Multi-factor authentication rollout
items.description: Enable and enforce MFA for email, remote access, and admin accounts with the client's existing identity provider, including user onboarding.

items.name: Phishing-resistant security key, per user
items.description: Hardware security key for administrators and high-risk users, enrolled during the MFA rollout. Better tier.

items.name: Privileged access review
items.description: Review admin and service accounts, remove excess rights, and set a review schedule.

items.name: Network segmentation on existing switches
items.description: Design and configure VLANs and access rules to separate cameras, access control, guest, and business networks. Good tier.

items.name: Next-generation firewall with segmentation
items.description: Firewall appliance with zone-based segmentation, configured and documented. Better tier. Annual license not included.

items.name: Server room environmental monitoring kit
items.description: Temperature, humidity, and water sensors with alerting for the server or network room.

items.name: Endpoint detection and response, per endpoint
items.description: EDR license per endpoint per year, deployed and tuned; the client's team watches alerts. Good tier.

items.name: Managed detection and response, per endpoint
items.description: EDR with a 24x7 monitoring and response service, per endpoint per month. Better tier.

items.name: Centralized logging onboarding
items.description: Send key log sources (identity, firewall, servers, email, access control, video) to a central log platform with retention set and basic physical and cyber correlation rules.

items.name: Managed log monitoring service
items.description: Hosted log platform with alert monitoring, per site per month. Better tier.

items.name: Incident response plan and playbooks
items.description: Incident response plan with declaration criteria, triage and escalation, evidence handling, notification, and containment playbooks.

items.name: Tabletop exercise
items.description: Facilitated tabletop exercise on a combined physical and cyber scenario, with an after-action report.

items.name: Backup configuration and restore test
items.description: Fix backup scope and schedule, separate backup credentials, and run a documented restore test. Good tier.

items.name: Immutable off-site backup, per TB
items.description: Off-site backup with immutable retention, per TB per month. Better tier.

items.name: Recovery plan and objectives
items.description: Set recovery time and point objectives, write the recovery plan, and draft recovery communications.

items.name: Cryptographic inventory
items.description: Inventory of algorithms, keys, certificates, and protocols in use, flagging quantum-vulnerable public-key algorithms and long-lived sensitive data.

items.name: Post-quantum migration planning
items.description: Prioritized migration plan toward the NIST post-quantum standards (FIPS 203, 204, 205), crypto agility recommendations, vendor roadmap review, and a hybrid test plan.

items.name: Encryption at rest and in transit remediation
items.description: Turn on disk and database encryption and enforce modern TLS on in-scope systems.
